cards.title: ① Validate & Select Route
items: Order must be PAID + AT_HUB (400 otherwise)
No active mission or unconfirmed incident for this order
Bundle validation if bundledOrderIds provided
Route selection: routeId from request, or recommended+feasible fallback
Guard: 400 if selected route is infeasible (energy > 80% safe reserve)

cards.title: ② Create Records
items: Mission: SCHEDULED, handling_status=AT_HUB, drone+battery assigned
MissionLeg per route segment: PENDING, battery_id per leg
Leg 0 uses assigned battery; relay legs use validated swap batteries
AIPrediction: stores energy, duration, risk, recommendation_content
Order.planning_at set, replan_required_at cleared

cards.title: ③ Auto-Dispatch (XAI SHAP)
items: Replaces manual drone/battery/route selection
Drone: 4 criteria (locality 35, payload 25, readiness 25, fleet util 15)
Battery: 4 criteria (reserve 40, SoC 25, mount 20, health 15)
Route: 4 criteria (safety 35, energy 25, SLA fit 25, simplicity 15)
dry_run=True: preview XAI without creating mission
Additive SHAP: base_value + sum(shap_values) == total_score

cards.title: recommendation_content
items: Manual: stores selected route's reason string
Auto-dispatch: stores [Auto-Dispatch XAI] executive_summary
Persisted in AIPrediction table for audit trail
Captures AI reasoning at mission creation time
